sections.name: TermsPage
sections.title: Terms of use text
sections.what: The text of the Terms of use page. It says the app is free with no money or prizes, the beta is for adults, and it sets rules for behaviour, data use, and accounts.
sections.why: Likely reason: the terms are shown in the app so users can read them before signing up.
sections.watch_out: The page says it is a draft, so it should not be treated as final legal wording.

summary: Static Terms of use page for the ALTER EGO beta, marked as a draft for legal review.
purpose: Shows the rules users agree to: the app is free, the beta is for people 18 and over, acceptable behaviour, and where data comes from.
why: Likely reason: the terms are written into the app so users can read them before signing up.
how: 1. Set the page title. 2. Show the heading and draft banner. 3. Show sections on free play, age, acceptable use, data, and the user's account, with links to attributions, settings and the privacy notice.
inputs: None. The page takes no user input.
risks: The text is a draft and is not reviewed legal wording. Changes here are not linked to the rules they describe, so they can drift apart.
debug: If the wording is wrong, edit this file. If a link is broken, check the target paths named in the links.
